what.text: This page follows refugees from Serbia and Kosovo living in Switzerland, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1541 refugees from Serbia and Kosovo in Switzerland, 5.2% of all refugees from Serbia and Kosovo.
France hosts the most refugees from Serbia and Kosovo, followed by Germany, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kosovo territory in Serbia with the UCK in 1998 and 1999.
It also records armed conflicts over Croatia territory in 1991 and 1992 and over Slovenia territory in 1991.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at 3229 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 12493, at the end of 2001; the main years of displacement in the data are 1997 and 2000 to 2009.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Switzerland.
These are year-end totals for Switzerland only, reported to UNHCR.
